sources.название: Feature extraction and prediction of spinal cord stimulation evoked compound action potentials in humans
sources.авторы: König, S.; Ramadan, A.; Sullivan, D. et al.
sources.модальность: Epidural SCS ECAP waveforms recorded through two externalized percutaneous leads
sources.задача: Classify individual pulses as ECAP, non-ECAP or artifact and model waveform features across stimulation settings
sources.метод: Artifact cleaning, PCA clustering, K-nearest-neighbor classification and generalized linear mixed-effects models
sources.датасет: Fifteen chronic-pain participants recruited; 30 sessions from eight participants with externalized two-lead SCS selected, followed by exclusion of two sessions from one participant for uncertain electrode alignment
sources.производительность: AUC separated ECAP from non-ECAP better than peak-to-peak amplitude (d'=2.44 versus 2.27); preferred polarities reduced current by about 1.25 mA
sources.кросс_субъект: no: participant variability was modeled, but no held-out-participant validation is reported
sources.ограничения: Eight selected participants out of 15 recruited and 28 retained sessions after two exclusions. Nested k-fold classification selected every 11th waveform per outer loop; no participant-held-out evaluation or external cohort. Underlying data are available only on author request subject to ethics/IRB restrictions. ECAP classes and features are neural-response measures, not pain or treatment outcomes.

sources.название: Connectome-constrained networks predict neural activity across the fly visual system
sources.авторы: Janne K. Lappalainen; Fabian D. Tschopp; Sridhama Prakhya; Mason McGill; Aljoscha Nern; Kazunori Shinomiya; Shin-ya Takemura; Eyal Gruntman; Jakob H. Macke; Srinivas C. Turaga
sources.задача: Оценка идентифицируемости и вклада структурных ограничений коннектома
sources.метод: Connectome-constrained deep mechanistic network with simplified neurons and synapses, optimized for visual motion
sources.датасет: Compiled adult fly visual-system connectome; official flyvis scaffold fib25-fib19_v2.2.json; 64 cell types
sources.производительность: Predicts neural responses across 64 visual-system cell types and tests connectome-derived constraints.
sources.ограничения: The 64-cell-type visual network predicts measured single-neuron visual responses. The official flyvis implementation names the compiled scaffold fib25-fib19_v2.2.json; this is a constructed file, not a single FlyWire/BANC release. The endpoint is visual function, not VNC, nociception, ECAP or SCS.

provenance.query_or_seed: connectome-constrained dynamics transfer random graph controls

evidence.population: Adult Drosophila visual system; 64 modeled cell types with published functional recordings
evidence.sample_size: 64 modeled optic-lobe cell types; 45,669 model neurons; 1,513,231 model connections across 721 columns; 50 independently trained DMNs; comparisons to published neural recordings from 26 studies (not 26 animals).

validation.notes: The 64-cell-type visual network predicts measured single-neuron visual responses. The official flyvis implementation names the compiled scaffold fib25-fib19_v2.2.json; this is a constructed file, not a single FlyWire/BANC release. The endpoint is visual function, not VNC, nociception, ECAP or SCS. A prior relation to bioRxiv 10.1101/2023.05.02.539144 was removed: that preprint is Shiu et al., a distinct adult-brain model. BioRxiv 10.1101/2023.03.11.532232 matches Lappalainen et al. by title and authors, but a formal publisher-declared version link was not verified. Rechecked 2026-09-28: model predictions were compared with published neural recordings from 26 studies without fitting to those recordings; this is external within-species functional comparison, not human transfer. The paper reports 95% confidence intervals for some cross-model correlations, not predictive uncertainty or calibration. Model size and ensemble count are not biological animal sample sizes.

sources.название: Evoked potentials recorded from the spinal cord during neurostimulation for pain: a computational modeling study
sources.авторы: Carlos J. Anaya; Hans J. Zander; Robert D. Graham; Vishwanath Sankarasubramanian; Scott F. Lempka
sources.модальность: Simulated spinal ECAP and published human ECAP trace comparator
sources.задача: Explain the neural and physical origins of ECAPs recorded from SCS leads
sources.метод: Lower-thoracic 3-D finite-element volume conductor in COMSOL, multicompartment dorsal-column sensory axons in NEURON, and reciprocity-based projection of axonal transmembrane currents to inactive lead contacts
sources.датасет: Literature-based canonical human anatomy and axon-density inputs; one previously published clinical ECAP trace shown as a comparator in Figure 2C, not a new patient cohort
sources.производительность: At assumed model discomfort threshold, Figure 2C shows clinical and model P2-N1 amplitudes of 200 and 216 microvolts; qualitative N1/P2 morphology and latency agreement, not patient-independent prediction
sources.кросс_субъект: not_applicable: no patient-level model training or held-out-patient test
sources.ограничения: Canonical literature-based anatomy and lead placement omit interpatient variation. Model sensory threshold is assumed at at least 10% dorsal-column activation and discomfort threshold at 1.4 times this threshold, without established clinical mapping. Dorsal horn neurons are excluded; no new patient-linked pain-outcome validation.

provenance.import_source: NS-07 PMC author-manuscript BioC full text
provenance.query_or_seed: Anaya Zander Lempka ECAP computational modeling reciprocity

sources.авторы: Meagan K. Brucker-Hahn; Hans J. Zander; Andrew J. Will; Jayesh C. Vallabh; Jason S. Wolff; David A. Dinsmoor; Scott F. Lempka
sources.модальность: Human spinal ECAP recordings plus computational dorsal-column recruitment model
sources.задача: Measure how posture and pulse width alter spinal ECAP features and test whether constant ECAP amplitude implies constant neural recruitment
sources.метод: Acute externalized SCS-trial ECAP growth-curve sweeps across postures and 90-300 microsecond pulse widths; artifact model and growth-curve estimation; FEM and 10,000 dorsal-column axons with reciprocity-based ECAP simulation across dorsal CSF thicknesses
sources.датасет: 56 trial participants and 479 trials; 195 trials excluded from growth-curve fitting; analyzed 284 datasets from 45 participants. Human recordings are commercially sensitive and available only upon reasonable request, not public download.
sources.производительность: Experimental supine versus seated ECAP threshold was 65.7% lower and growth rate 178.5% higher; in the model a fixed 25 microvolt ECAP required 94% more activated axons at 4.4 mm versus 2.0 mm dorsal CSF thickness
sources.кросс_субъект: not_applicable: descriptive repeated-measure analysis, no held-out participant predictive model
sources.ограничения: Acute trial-phase recordings only; 11 of 56 participants had all growth-curve trials excluded. Model lacked stimulation artifact and biological noise, used averaged anatomy, and did not predict patient-linked analgesic outcomes. Constant ECAP amplitude failed to guarantee constant recruitment in simulation.

sources.название: A Drosophila computational brain model reveals sensorimotor processing
sources.авторы: Philip K. Shiu; Gabriella R. Sterne; Nico Spiller; Romain Franconville; Andrea Sandoval; et al.
sources.модальность: Adult Drosophila FlyWire central-brain connectome, predicted neurotransmitter identity, simulated spike activity, optogenetic activation and feeding/grooming observations
sources.задача: Predict sensorimotor responses in feeding and antennal grooming circuits from a whole-brain connectome model
sources.метод: Brainwide leaky integrate-and-fire model with alpha-synapse dynamics on connectome weights and predicted excitatory/inhibitory identities; sensory and interneuron activation compared with neural and behavioral experiments
sources.датасет: Adult FlyWire central-brain connectome, public materialization v.630, with 127,400 proofread neurons included in the leaky integrate-and-fire model; the article describes over 125,000 neurons and 50 million synaptic connections in the broader connectome.
sources.производительность: Model predictions of taste-responsive and feeding-initiating neurons, taste interactions and antennal grooming circuits are tested by optogenetic activation and behavioral or neural observations; no pain, ECAP or SCS metric
sources.кросс_субъект: not_applicable: connectome simulation and fly experiments, not human participant prediction
sources.ограничения: The model concerns adult central-brain feeding and grooming circuits, not VNC walking or nociceptive subjective pain. Authors caution that absolute model firing rates are unreliable because morphology, receptor dynamics, gap junctions, peptides and neuromodulation are omitted. Fly experiments validate scoped circuit hypotheses, not human ECAP or SCS outcomes.

meta.scope: Prospective method for human ECAP growth-curve modelling with Drosophila connectome-constrained pretraining, a separate biophysical formation/recording operator, and matched participant-level evaluation; SCS control and clinical response remain conditional extensions.
invariants: A simulation label is not subjective human pain.
ECAP measures evoked neural recruitment and is not a direct measure of pain.
Drosophila is not treated as a direct model or digital twin of the human spinal cord.
Clinical SCS claims require patient-level human ECAP or telemetry linked to a pre-specified clinical outcome.
meta.author_review_scope: Delegated EVD-05 acceptance of bounded evidence conclusions on 2026-09-30; future substantive evidence changes and experiment proposals still require review. This does not approve the topic or establish GO.

entities.name: noxious_stimulus
entities.carrier: simulation environment or experimental stimulus apparatus
entities.measurement: commanded location, intensity, duration, and waveform
entities.permitted_conclusion: The applied exposure can be detected or its parameters can be estimated.

entities.name: nociceptive_response
entities.carrier: sensory and downstream neural or physiological system
entities.measurement: neural activity or physiological response after a noxious stimulus
entities.analysis_unit: trial within an animal or participant
entities.permitted_conclusion: A measurable response associated with potentially tissue-damaging stimulation occurred.
entities.prohibited_interpretation: The response is equivalent to subjective pain or chronic pain.

entities.name: protective_behavior
entities.measurement: movement, pose, withdrawal, guarding, or expert behavioral annotation
entities.permitted_conclusion: Observable protective behavior was detected under the defined protocol.
entities.prohibited_interpretation: Behavior alone quantifies subjective pain intensity.

entities.name: abstract_dynamic_representation
entities.carrier: connectome-constrained Drosophila simulation and its explicitly defined latent state
entities.measurement: initial parameters of a pretrained temporal module; latent trajectories describe the training representation, not human anatomy or measured ECAP
entities.analysis_unit: trial nested in a held-out synthetic individual and scenario
entities.permitted_conclusion: A proposed temporal prior may be adapted to a separately specified human recruitment module; benefit requires matched independent comparison.
entities.prohibited_interpretation: The latent state is subjective pain, a human spinal-cord state, or an ECAP waveform.

entities.name: ecap_neural_recruitment
entities.carrier: electrically stimulated and recorded human neural tissue
entities.measurement: artifact-controlled evoked compound action-potential morphology, latency, area, and peak-to-peak amplitude
entities.time_scale: sub-millisecond to tens of milliseconds after a stimulation pulse
entities.analysis_unit: pulse nested in electrode configuration, session, and participant
entities.permitted_conclusion: The signal characterizes evoked neural recruitment and stimulation delivery under the recording configuration.
entities.prohibited_interpretation: ECAP is a direct measure of pain or proves clinical benefit.

entities.name: scs_response
entities.carrier: human patient receiving spinal cord stimulation
entities.measurement: pre-specified patient-level clinical outcome at a fixed follow-up time
entities.permitted_conclusion: The model predicts the defined clinical outcome in an independent patient-level evaluation.
entities.prohibited_interpretation: A waveform-only or within-patient window result establishes therapeutic efficacy or cross-subject prediction.

simulation_domain.neural_scope: Peripheral nociceptors and connectome-addressable ascending nociceptive neurons implicated in rapid escape and sustained avoidance; exact cell/root IDs must be frozen in the simulator manifest for the selected connectome release.
state_variables: neuron activation or spike state when the selected simulator supports it
synaptic input and output state when exposed by the simulator
body pose, joint state, contact state, and locomotor state
environment and stimulus state retained for audit but withheld from a detector when it is the target
stimuli: localized noxious thermal exposure when supported by the selected sensory model
observable_behaviors: locomotor trajectory and pose-derived protective response
simulation_domain.fallback_domain: A separate larval Class-IV multidendritic-nociceptor escape/rolling circuit may be used only as an explicitly different experiment; adult and larval circuits are not pooled.

experiments.name: simulation_stimulus_detection
experiments.input: simulated neural, pose, movement, or behavioral observations without the stimulus command
experiments.output: location, intensity, duration, or presence of a noxious stimulus
experiments.training_data: synthetic individuals and scenarios assigned only to training
experiments.independent_test: held-out synthetic individuals and held-out stimulus scenarios
experiments.success_criterion: pre-registered improvement over chance and leakage controls with confidence intervals
experiments.falsification_criterion: performance collapses after removing the stimulus command or under individual/scenario holdout

experiments.name: simulation_response_estimation
experiments.input: stimulus parameters and pre-stimulus simulation state
experiments.training_data: synthetic individuals and perturbations assigned only to training
experiments.independent_test: held-out individuals, parameter ranges, and perturbations
experiments.success_criterion: response features remain identifiable and calibrated under pre-registered perturbations
experiments.falsification_criterion: the response is not distinguishable from control or is determined by metadata leakage

experiments.name: physical_ecap_observation_validation
experiments.input: electrically recruited population activity passed through an explicit conduction, volume-conduction, electrode, artifact, and acquisition model
experiments.training_data: simulated recruitment conditions plus the training partition of authorized human ECAP recordings
experiments.independent_test: held-out participants, electrode configurations, and stimulation settings from human ECAP data
experiments.success_criterion: pre-registered waveform, latency, recruitment, and artifact characteristics satisfy bounds fixed from the human training reference
experiments.falsification_criterion: the physical observation model fails a required characteristic or matches only participants and configurations seen during fitting

experiments.name: scs_programming_and_evaluation
experiments.input: human ECAP or SCS telemetry, stimulation settings, and only for the clinical subtask pre-specified patient covariates
experiments.output: primary ECAP growth-curve modelling comparison; setting/control and linked clinical outcome prediction are separate conditional extensions
experiments.training_data: authorized human SCS cohort split by participant; clinical labels are optional and task-specific
experiments.independent_test: held-out patients or a separate SCS cohort, with unseen settings where the task requires them
experiments.success_criterion: practically meaningful growth-curve accuracy gain over all prespecified matched controls, including the simple static model, on independent participants with calibration within tolerance
experiments.falsification_criterion: eligible locked data establish no meaningful gain or calibration failure; leakage invalidates generalization, and unavailable target data block evaluation rather than refute the hypothesis

transfer_chain.input: neural activity, simulation state, movement, pose, and protective behavior
transfer_chain.output: pretrained temporal-module parameters and versioned synthetic time series with explicit configuration, units and seed; nociceptive interpretations require compatible observations
transfer_chain.success_criterion: representation preserves pre-registered stimulus and response information under perturbation
transfer_chain.falsification_criterion: representation depends on command leakage or fails individual/scenario holdout

transfer_chain.input: initial parameters of the Drosophila-pretrained temporal module, adapted in dimension and time scale within human training folds
transfer_chain.output: human population-response module feeding a separate biophysical ECAP operator; no asserted neuron correspondence or direct fly-to-ECAP signal conversion
transfer_chain.training_data: synthetic individuals plus only the training partition of human recruitment data
transfer_chain.independent_test: held-out human participants and stimulation configurations
transfer_chain.success_criterion: prespecified practically meaningful gain over all matched controls, including human-only, human-ECAP synthetic, shuffled dynamics, graph-null and simple growth-curve models, without calibration loss beyond tolerance
transfer_chain.falsification_criterion: no defensible dynamical correspondence stops transfer claims; an eligible locked comparison refutes meaningful benefit only when intervals establish insufficient gain or unacceptable calibration; insufficient precision is undetermined

transfer_chain.input: population recruitment state, path lengths, fiber parameters, electrode geometry, stimulation settings, and acquisition disturbances
transfer_chain.output: artifact-controlled ECAP-like waveform with morphology, latency, amplitude, area, and recruitment descriptors
transfer_chain.training_data: physical simulations and the training partition of human ECAP comparator data
transfer_chain.independent_test: held-out participants, configurations, and stimulation settings
transfer_chain.success_criterion: all pre-registered physical and signal characteristics satisfy held-out comparator criteria
transfer_chain.falsification_criterion: any required characteristic fails or the result is reproduced by an unphysical aggregate or artifact shortcut

transfer_chain.input: validated human ECAP or telemetry representation plus stimulation settings and task-specific covariates
transfer_chain.output: primary technical target: ECAP growth curve; waveform/time characteristics test operator validity and need for the temporal module. SCS control and clinical response require separately approved extensions.
transfer_chain.training_data: participant-disjoint SCS training data containing the exact target required by the declared task
transfer_chain.independent_test: held-out SCS patients or a separate cohort; clinical claims additionally require linked outcomes and follow-up
transfer_chain.success_criterion: practically meaningful growth-curve accuracy gain over all prespecified matched controls, including the simple static model, on independent participants with calibration within tolerance
transfer_chain.falsification_criterion: eligible locked data establish no meaningful gain or calibration failure; leakage invalidates generalization, and unavailable target data block evaluation rather than refute the hypothesis

ecap_like_observation_model.source_activity: population transmembrane action potentials elicited by electrical stimulation
ecap_like_observation_model.conduction_delays: path-length and fiber-parameter dependent delays applied before summation
ecap_like_observation_model.spatial_summation: signed summation over recruited fibers with distance and orientation weighting
ecap_like_observation_model.electrode_geometry: explicit stimulation and recording contact positions, spacing, polarity, and reference
ecap_like_observation_model.volume_conduction: forward observation operator from neural sources to recording contacts
disturbances: physiological noise including EMG and movement
measurable_characteristics: waveform morphology and classifiability against non-ECAP and artifact waveforms
N1 and later-component latency relative to stimulation
area under the curve and peak-to-peak amplitude
recruitment threshold and response versus amplitude, pulse width, polarity, and contact geometry

tolerance_protocol.reference: participant- and configuration-stratified distributions from held-out human ECAP data
tolerance_protocol.acceptance_rule: Before analysis, register metric-specific bounds from the human training reference only; every required characteristic must fall within its registered 95% reference interval or registered standardized-distance bound on held-out human data.
tolerance_protocol.reason_numeric_bounds_are_null: Raw comparator signals and a locked preprocessing protocol are required; inventing numeric bounds from abstracts would be unsupported.
tolerance_protocol.failure_rule: Failure of any required characteristic keeps the label ECAP-like only and blocks claims of human ECAP equivalence.

ecap_like_observation_model.prohibited_claim: A raw aggregate of simulator activity is an ECAP or a direct measure of pain.

stop_criteria.trigger: The simulator cannot be reproduced from fixed code, configuration, and seed, or target performance is explained by direct access to the stimulus command.
stop_criteria.measurement: independent rerun plus command-removal and leakage-control evaluation
stop_criteria.decision: stop claims for H1 and do not proceed with the affected representation
stop_criteria.reserve_result: release the simulator audit, failure analysis, and a bounded stimulus/response benchmark if reproducible components remain
stop_criteria.forbidden_conclusion: The simulator models pain or provides valid pretraining data.

stop_criteria.trigger: No Drosophila-derived dynamical observable can be mapped to a defensible human neural-recruitment descriptor without anatomical or semantic equivalence assumptions.
stop_criteria.measurement: completed representation-correspondence matrix with every candidate path marked absent, unjustified, or testable
stop_criteria.reserve_result: retain a Drosophila simulation, dataset-generation, and physical ECAP-modeling contribution as separate results
stop_criteria.forbidden_conclusion: Drosophila dynamics transfer to human spinal-cord recruitment or pain assessment.

stop_criteria.trigger: An eligible locked participant-level comparison establishes no prespecified practically meaningful gain against a required control or calibration degradation beyond the allowed tolerance. A nonsignificant point estimate alone does not trigger rejection.
stop_criteria.measurement: participant-level confidence intervals for control error minus transfer error and calibration difference, with multiplicity rules fixed before independent evaluation
stop_criteria.decision: report confirmed absence of practical benefit, deterioration or unacceptable calibration as applicable; leave overlapping intervals undetermined and missing data unevaluated
stop_criteria.reserve_result: report bounded negative or inconclusive results and applicability limits; neither insufficient precision nor unavailable data proves a null transfer effect
stop_criteria.forbidden_conclusion: Connectome-constrained Drosophila pretraining improves human ECAP or SCS tasks.

stop_criteria.trigger: No legally and ethically available human dataset links SCS telemetry or ECAP to a pre-specified patient-level clinical outcome and follow-up time.
stop_criteria.measurement: documented dataset-access and field audit before the SCS experiment
stop_criteria.decision: do not run or claim clinical SCS-response prediction
stop_criteria.reserve_result: limit the dissertation result to Drosophila dynamics, ECAP-like physical observation modeling, and non-clinical human ECAP or SCS tasks supported by available data
stop_criteria.forbidden_conclusion: The method predicts clinical response to SCS.

stop_criteria.trigger: Performance exists only for windows from patients seen in training or disappears when patients are held out.
stop_criteria.measurement: patient-disjoint evaluation with participant-level confidence intervals
stop_criteria.forbidden_conclusion: The model predicts SCS response for new patients.

pending_decisions: Author review of future experiment protocols and substantive changes beyond the accepted bounded evidence conclusions.
Supervisor decision on H1-H3, the reserve scenario, and G0.
Selection of primary and independent human ECAP or SCS datasets after lawful access and target compatibility are confirmed.
Numeric ECAP-like tolerances after raw human comparator access and protocol lock.

resolved_decisions.historical_requirement: Author review of the evidence matrix.
resolved_decisions.scope: EVD-05 bounded evidence conclusions and disputed cluster boundaries; no supervisor or experiment approval

ipr_evaluation_protocol.primary_target: ECAP growth curve: amplitude versus stimulation intensity
ipr_evaluation_protocol.transfer_object: initial parameters of a temporal module, adapted within human training folds
ipr_evaluation_protocol.unit_of_inference: participant; pulses, electrode configurations and sessions are repeated measurements
ipr_evaluation_protocol.independent_validation_boundary: Final transfer-test participants are not used to calibrate or revise the human physical operator; separate participant partitions are fixed before independent testing.
matched_conditions: random initialization policy; pretrained parameters vary only with the experimental condition
ipr_evaluation_protocol.lock_before_independent_test: Use human training data to justify sample size, configuration coverage and interval precision; freeze scores, tolerances, splits and multiplicity rules by November 2028 before accessing the independent test partition.
ipr_evaluation_protocol.gain_definition: error of control minus error of transfer; higher is better

outcomes.practical_gain_supported: For every required comparator the gain interval lies wholly above the prespecified practical threshold and calibration remains within tolerance.
outcomes.practical_gain_absent: For at least one required comparator the gain interval lies wholly below the practical threshold; identify that comparator and do not generalize beyond the tested design.
outcomes.deterioration: Gain interval wholly below zero or calibration difference establishes unacceptable degradation.
outcomes.undetermined: Intervals overlap decision boundaries, precision is insufficient, or calibration remains uncertain.
outcomes.not_evaluated: Required data, independent split, permissions or representation correspondence are absent.

conditions.result: select primary and independent ECAP data after access and suitability checks
fix compatible graph/observations, licenses and input versions
separate pilot checks of Drosophila model and ECAP-like operator
lock metric, thresholds, sample adequacy, splits and statistical plan
complete primary comparison if conditions hold

ipr_evaluation_protocol.reserve: Without human data retain computational validation, identifiability and uncertainty analyses; without defensible transfer retain separate Drosophila and ECAP-like models. Neither fulfills independent human validation. Revisions require supervisor consideration.

meta.rule: Each row has exactly one primary target construct. Datasets with different constructs are not pooled into one metric.

compatibility_rules.condition: Targets must be harmonized as protocol-defined experimental classes; modality-specific encoders and participant-disjoint splits remain mandatory.
A common metric is allowed only after a single compatible self-report definition, scale transform, time reference, and population scope are pre-registered; otherwise evaluate separately.
Behavioral annotation remains a separate endpoint.
Responsiveness to a potentially nociceptive procedure remains separate from self-reported pain.
Resting-state group phenotype remains separate from evoked experimental and self-report targets.
